message: Object created directly from request data (mass assignment)
fix: Permit an explicit field allowlist before mass-assigning attributes
fail:
class UsersController < ApplicationController
  def create
    user = User.create(params[:user])
  end
end
pass:
class UsersController < ApplicationController
  def create
    user = User.create(user_params)
  end

  def user_params
    params.require(:user).permit(:name, :email)
  end
end

message: render file: target comes from request input (path traversal)
fix: Render a fixed template or resolve the path against a trusted root
fail:
class PagesController < ApplicationController
  def show
    render file: params[:page]
  end
end
pass:
class PagesController < ApplicationController
  def show
    render file: Rails.root.join("public", "404.html")
  end
end

message: render inline: template comes from request input (SSTI)
fix: Use a fixed template file instead of inlining user-controlled ERB
fail:
class EmailsController < ApplicationController
  def preview
    render inline: params[:template]
  end
end
pass:
class EmailsController < ApplicationController
  def preview
    render inline: @welcome_template
  end
end

message: Outbound HTTP request URL taken from request input (SSRF)
fix: Allowlist destination hosts or map the parameter to known endpoints
fail:
class FetchesController < ApplicationController
  def show
    resp = HTTParty.get(params[:url])
  end
end
pass:
class FetchesController < ApplicationController
  def show
    resp = HTTParty.get("https://api.example.com/status")
  end
end

message: require() target taken from request input (code load)
fix: Require a fixed set of modules; never load paths from user input
fail:
class PluginsController < ApplicationController
  def load_plugin
    require params[:plugin]
  end
end
pass:
class PluginsController < ApplicationController
  def load_plugin
    require "json"
  end
end

fix: Keep verify_authenticity_token enabled for cookie-authenticated routes
fail:
class WebhooksController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token, only: [:create]
end
pass:
class SessionsController < ApplicationController
  protect_from_forgery with: :exception
end

fix: Use Oj.strict_load or parse plain JSON for untrusted input
fail:
class EventsController < ApplicationController
  def create
    data = Oj.load(request.raw_post)
  end
end
pass:
class EventsController < ApplicationController
  def create
    payload = Oj.dump(event)
  end
end

message: File write path taken from request input (path traversal)
fix: Resolve the path under a fixed upload root and reject traversal
fail:
class UploadsController < ApplicationController
  def create
    File.write(params[:path], params[:content])
  end
end
pass:
class UploadsController < ApplicationController
  def create
    File.write(Rails.root.join("log", "events.log"), line)
  end
end

message: Regex built from request input (ReDoS via catastrophic backtracking)
fix: Constrain the pattern, cap input length, or use a linear-time engine
fail:
class SearchesController < ApplicationController
  def index
    re = Regexp.new(params[:pattern])
  end
end
pass:
class SearchesController < ApplicationController
  def index
    re = Regexp.new("\\A[a-z]+\\z")
  end
end

message: Untrusted request data written straight to logs (log injection)
fix: Sanitize or structure-log the value instead of interpolating raw input
fail:
class SearchesController < ApplicationController
  def index
    Rails.logger.info("search: " + params[:q])
  end
end
pass:
class SearchesController < ApplicationController
  def index
    Rails.logger.info("server started")
  end
end

fix: Use AES-256-GCM with a random nonce
fail:
class TokensController < ApplicationController
  def show
    cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new("aes-256-ecb")
  end
end
pass:
class TokensController < ApplicationController
  def show
    cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new("aes-256-gcm")
  end
end

message: JNDI lookup name comes from request input (injection)
fix: Restrict lookups to a fixed naming context; never pass request data to lookup()
Allowlist destination hosts or map the parameter to known endpoints

message: HTTP header value taken from request input (response splitting)
fix: Validate header values and strip CR/LF before writing

message: Jackson default typing enabled (polymorphic deserialization RCE)
fix: Remove default typing; allowlist concrete types with @JsonSubTypes
Use SafeConstructor or parse with a schema-limited loader

message: GroovyShell.evaluate runs untrusted script text (code injection)
fix: Do not evaluate dynamic scripts; use a sandboxed template engine

message: Spring Boot actuator endpoints fully exposed (env/heapdump/htrace)
fix: Expose only needed endpoints, e.g. health,info, and secure them
